about_the_game:
In the frigid world of the flightless, all that’s left to do is fight! Flightless Fighters is a 2D Fighter with a retro feel to its graphics and sound, and a fun conceptual twist. It prides itself on its humorous but genuine gameplay, which facilitates an upbeat tone. 18 lively characters corresponding to each Penguin species allow for experimentation with strategy and give room for many different playstyles to develop.

There are a variety of elements that contribute to Flightless Fighters’ style of gameplay. Its artwork and sound design have a retro stylization with pixel art and chiptune music, creating an exciting atmosphere. The character, sound, and animation design serve to personify the penguins, adding to the unique and amusing experience. Most importantly, Flightless Fighters has a fun and comical core, but knows how to take itself seriously. The audiovisual components reflect the absurdity of the idea, but the realistic mechanics create both contrast and synergy. The concept is incredibly silly, but the gameplay feels tangible and real, perhaps furthering the humor even so.
